user_query: I'm planning a movie night with my family and we want to discuss recent movie news. Fetch the latest movie headlines and provide us with articles related to superhero movies, especially Superman. Can you also search for movie topics on Medium and give us some stories related to those topics?

TaskList.description: Fetch the latest movie headlines from a news API.
Filter the fetched headlines to find articles specifically related to superhero movies, focusing on Superman.
Search for movie-related topics on Medium using their API.
Retrieve stories related to the searched movie topics from Medium.
